zhang2022.citation: Zhang H, Zhang Y, Wang L, Song H, Li Z. Detection of odor difference between human milk and infant formula by sensory-directed analysis. Food Chem 2022, 382, 132348.

ullrich1987.citation: Ullrich F, Grosch W. Identification of the most intense volatile flavour compounds formed during autoxidation of linoleic acid. Z Lebensm Unters Forsch 1987, 184, 277-282.

frankel1983.citation: Frankel EN. Volatile lipid oxidation products. Prog Lipid Res 1983, 22, 1-33.

li2023.citation: Li Y, Wang H, Li R, Liu G, Zhong K, Gao L, Zhu B, Jin A, et al. Monitoring volatile changes in infant formula during long-term storage at room temperature. Curr Res Food Sci 2023, 7, 100645.

gb2760.zh: GB 2760-2024 表 B.1：婴幼儿配方食品（食品分类号 13.01）不得添加食品用香料、香精；脚注规定，使用范围涵盖 0~6 月龄婴幼儿配方食品的不得添加任何食用香料。
gb2760.en: GB 2760-2024 Table B.1: flavorings may not be added to infant formula foods (food category 13.01); its footnote states that no flavoring at all may be added to formula whose range covers infants aged 0 to 6 months.

gb10765_fortifier.zh: GB 10765-2021 第 3.9.1 条：食品添加剂和营养强化剂的使用应符合 GB 2760 和 GB 14880 的规定。
gb10765_fortifier.en: GB 10765-2021, clause 3.9.1: food additives and nutrient fortifiers must comply with GB 2760 and GB 14880.

linoleic_acid.status_zh: 允许，且为婴儿配方食品的必需成分，含量须在规定范围内（0.07~0.33 g/100 kJ；亚油酸与 α-亚麻酸之比 5:1~15:1）
linoleic_acid.status_en: Permitted; it is a mandatory component of infant formula and must stay within the specified range (0.07 to 0.33 g/100 kJ; linoleic to alpha-linolenic acid ratio 5:1 to 15:1)
linoleic_acid.short_zh: 允许；必需成分，有含量范围
linoleic_acid.short_en: Permitted; mandatory, with a specified range

oleic_acid.status_zh: 允许；标准中无单独限量，随食用油脂原料带入，原料须符合相应的食品安全标准
oleic_acid.status_en: Permitted; no specific limit in the standard. It comes with the edible oil raw materials, which must comply with the corresponding food safety standards

rows.pathway_zh: 脂质自氧化（亚油酸 9-氢过氧化物分解）
脂质自氧化（亚油酸 13-氢过氧化物分解）
脂质自氧化；也可由 1-辛烯-3-醇进一步氧化或热处理中脂肪酸深度降解生成
rows.pathway_en: Lipid autoxidation; also from further oxidation of 1-octen-3-ol or deep degradation of fatty acids during heat treatment

rows.pathway_zh: 脂质自氧化（亚油酸 10-氢过氧化物分解）
脂质自氧化（油酸 11-氢过氧化物分解）
脂质自氧化（主要为油酸 9-、10-氢过氧化物分解）
rows.pathway_en: Lipid autoxidation (mainly decomposition of the oleate 9- and 10-hydroperoxides)

rows.pathway_zh: 脂质自氧化（油酸 9-氢过氧化物分解）
脂质氧化（亚油酸 12-氢过氧化物分解）
脂质氧化（亚油酸 9-氢过氧化物经环过氧化物生成）；另有文献认为可能来自美拉德反应
rows.pathway_en: Lipid oxidation (from the linoleate 9-hydroperoxide via a cyclic peroxide); another study suggests it may also come from the Maillard reaction
